# Vendored QR encoder

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from
[qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator), version 2.0.4,
commit `83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8`, file `js/dist/qrcode.js`.

Copyright Kazuhiko Arase. Distributed under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`).
Bundled locally so generating QR codes needs no CDN or external service.
